epics.name: Mobile shell & app foundation
epics.goal: Bottom tab bar, bottom sheets, thumb-zone actions, dark mode, skeletons and the shared primitives every other epic renders into — the app feels native on a 390px phone.

epics.name: Auth & account security
epics.goal: Passkeys first, Google/Apple, step-up for sensitive actions, devices & sessions, email change, abuse limits, CSRF — low-friction sign-in that is also the most secure account the user has.

epics.name: Onboarding & activation
epics.goal: Five one-question screens on a phone that end in three real jobs and an alert; instant email verification; the extension offered at the right moment; a measured activation funnel.

epics.name: Dashboard
epics.goal: Real numbers, one next-best action, upcoming interviews, today's matches, streak and goals — the first screen answers 'what should I do now?' in five seconds.

epics.name: Job search & matching
epics.goal: Six ATS public APIs + one licensed aggregator into one store; MySQL full-text search with explainable ranking, preferences, feedback, Free daily matches and Pro match %.

epics.name: Saved jobs
epics.goal: Saved jobs are real SAVED applications with states (to apply / applied / not interested), reminders and one-tap apply hand-off.

epics.name: Applications tracker
epics.goal: Status history, notes, interviews, bulk actions, swipeable phone cards, inbox linkage and calendar export — the tracker that fills itself and never loses context.

epics.name: Job alerts & notification engine
epics.goal: Alerts as saved searches; one engine with per-kind channel matrix, quiet hours, daily digest, dedupe, web push and per-kind unsubscribe.

epics.name: AI Assistant (Ask Kiwiply)
epics.goal: A grounded, tool-using, budgeted chat over the user's own data with confirm-to-act, visible memory, 90-day retention and a Free path that never dead-ends.

epics.name: Interview Prep
epics.goal: Question bank, AI text practice (Pro, Phase 20.1), session history and the hand-off from a real upcoming interview.

epics.name: Messages
epics.goal: Recruiter threads from the user's own Gmail inbox, grouped per application, read-only with 'Reply in Gmail' — no Kiwiply mailbox, no in-app sending.

epics.name: Explore
epics.goal: Companies (from the posting store), roles, career paths and guides — real counts, real links, content from the catalog not sample data.

epics.name: Analytics
epics.goal: A real funnel: response and interview rates by resume, ATS, company and week, powered by events, the inbox and fill telemetry — honest empty states.

epics.name: My Profiles integration
epics.goal: The hub the Resume Builder's Common Profile (R1) fills: visibility, links, completeness → dashboard, and the removal of 'multiple profiles' in favour of targeted resumes.

epics.name: Settings, privacy & data
epics.goal: Notifications, privacy ('what we store, who sees it'), job preferences, AI data, support access, export/delete — every promise in plain language, every switch real.

epics.name: Billing & plan flows (in-app)
epics.goal: Upgrade sheet on 402 without leaving the page, usage meters, cancel/renew states, receipts — honest money UX per the locked billing rules.

epics.name: Engagement: streaks, goals, recap, referrals
epics.goal: Tasteful momentum: weekly goals, a streak that forgives, a Sunday recap, shareable milestones and a referral link — never dark patterns.

epics.name: PWA, push, offline, performance
epics.goal: Installable app, service worker with offline fallback, web push plumbing, Lighthouse budgets in CI, skeletons and optimistic UI everywhere.

epics.name: Product analytics & experiments
epics.goal: First-party, schema-validated events with privacy by design, rollups, funnel definitions and flag-based experiments.

epics.name: Accessibility, i18n readiness, QA & CI
epics.goal: AA accessibility, 44px targets, reduced motion, string extraction, Playwright + vitest in CI, visual smoke at 390/768/1440.

epics.name: Extension ↔ web hand-off
epics.goal: Connect, sync, save-a-job from the drawer, install prompts and the phone→laptop path — the two surfaces feel like one product.

stories.title: CSRF origin check, per-account backoff and login_attempt
stories.story: As the platform I want state-changing Next route handlers to verify Origin, and login/OTP/passkey to back off per account, so that cookie-auth cannot be abused cross-site or brute-forced.
stories.genz: Invisible safety; no CAPTCHA friction.
ac: `web/src/lib/csrf.ts` rejects POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE with a foreign Origin/Referer (403) on every route handler; the extension token path is unaffected
`login_attempt` table (hashed IP, no raw IP); thresholds 5→1 min, 10→15 min, 20→24 h + email; messages never reveal account existence
Admin security tile reads failed-login counts (A-area consumes)
stories.tech: web/src/lib/csrf.ts, web/src/app/api/**/route.ts, api AuthenticateController + new LoginAttemptService, Liquibase login_attempt

No user enumeration on login options
